value_grammar.decimal: Finite decimal, optionally in scientific notation: an optional leading '-', digits with an optional '.', then an optional exponent 'e' or 'E' with an optional '+' or '-' and one or more digits. No leading '+', whitespace, hexadecimal, infinity, NaN, or trailing characters. The value must be finite and inside the option's documented range; the decimal point is '.' in every locale.

process.usage: docenhance process INPUT --out-dir DIRECTORY --binarize fixed [--fixed-threshold T] [--json]

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Parent must exist. The final directory must not exist; processing writes a staged 8-bit grayscale PNG and publishes the directory only after success.

options.name: --binarize
options.description: Selects B03 fixed-threshold binarization. No other method is accepted.

options.name: --fixed-threshold
options.description: Normalized grayscale threshold. A sample is black iff its value is less than or equal to T.

options.name: --json
options.description: Writes exactly one final JSON response to stdout.

options.name: --help
options.description: Renders help and exits without opening input or creating output.
